name: milestone1_checkpoint_v2_768_per_plane
status: PREPARED — NOT TRAINED (awaiting explicit approval + GPU per 768 benchmark)

training.loss: weighted cross-entropy [bg=1, roof=3] (Dice term optional add-on)
training.device: cuda (recommended) — CPU impractical at 768, see hardware

dataset.note: When ~150 labels exist, use approved minus the FIXED holdout. Holdout stays identical for 50/100/150 comparability.
dataset.group_separation: house_group_id kept whole; train/holdout house-group leakage = NONE (verified)

evaluation.granularity: PER-PLANE (primary) — each plane-0N[-parapet].png evaluated individually; merged mask kept only as a secondary diagnostic

checkpoint_selection.rule: Select the epoch with the lowest per-plane mean perpendicular roofline error on the fixed holdout; break ties by higher horizontal coverage. Dice/IoU are reported but MUST NOT drive selection.

hardware.cpu_verdict: IMPRACTICAL for iterative 150-image checkpoints at 768 (~2.6 h per single run, 4 cores)

gpu_recommendation.expected_speedup_vs_cpu: ~50-100x (150-img epoch from ~9 min CPU to a few seconds GPU; full checkpoint minutes not hours)
gpu_recommendation.porting: device-agnostic; set device='cuda', model.to(device), tensors.to(device), increase batch_size
